definitions.explanation: Blocking or reflecting radiant heat, especially sunlight, to keep a space cooler. Common in building materials, paints, and films designed to reduce solar heat gain.

examples.japanese: {遮熱|しゃねつ}⟦シート→シート：10945_shiito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{塗料|とりょう}→塗料：24548_toryou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{遮熱|しゃねつ}⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This paint has a heat-shielding effect.

examples.english: Applying heat-shielding film to the windows can curb the rise in room temperature.

notes:
Reflecting or blocking radiant heat (mainly sunlight) before it enters a space. Distinct from ⟦{断熱|だんねつ}→断熱：06427_dannetsu⟧, which slows heat transfer through a material.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遮熱|しゃねつ}⟦{塗料|とりょう}→塗料：24548_toryou⟧: heat-shielding paint
- {遮熱|しゃねつ}⟦フィルム→フィルム：02951_firumu⟧: heat-shielding film
- {遮熱|しゃねつ}⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧: heat-shielding effect

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{断熱|だんねつ}→断熱：06427_dannetsu⟧: insulation — slows heat moving through walls and materials; {遮熱|しゃねつ} reflects radiant heat away before it enters
